description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Order Management product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Enterprise Command Center).   The supported version that is affected is V16. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Order Management.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Order Management accessible data as well as  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Oracle Order Management accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N).
